kept.depicts: A red-walled kernel furnace with glowing yellow and coral bars inside, topped by a large silver gear, a smaller copper gear, and a grey smokestack.

kept.name: e:kr-systable
kept.depicts: A dark grey-framed dispatch board holding a four-by-eight grid of cyan-indexed blue and grey slots with one active yellow entry.
A grey four-drawer vertical cabinet whose dark slots each hold a silver bar, three of them marked with a lit green square.
A brown brass padlock with yellow top trim, a silver shackle, a dark keyhole, and a small yellow key extending from its right side.
A narrow vertical dark grey signal housing on a post with three square lenses, the top red lens lit and the lower two dark.
A compact silver-grey boxy automaton in a black U-frame with two stubby feet, a glowing cyan, green, or yellow visor, and a tipped top antenna.

rework.depicts: A horizontal red bar clamped by two dark grey brackets with a detached vertical red needle hovering above a central notch.
A spoked grey wheel mounted on a dark base with six colour-coded task squares riding around its rim.

rework.name: e:kr-irqbell
rework.depicts: A bright yellow bell suspended from a dark grey bracket with a brown clapper hanging below.
rework.problem: ART-STYLE rule 6: floating bell; hang it from a bracket

deleted.depicts: A meshing pair of silver and copper toothed gears turning against each other.
deleted.reason: Generic mechanical filler that does not represent a specific kernel concept worth a manual page.

deleted.depicts: A wide dark console bezel scrolling bright green kernel log fragments such as FUTEX and EXT4-FS above a green status lamp.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 2: truncated text ("FUTE EXT4") is the whole prop

deleted.depicts: A narrow vertical dark grey cylinder hovering above a flat light grey rail.
deleted.reason: Visually unclear generic cylinder-and-rail filler without a distinct computing concept.

deleted.depicts: A small grey-bezelled black panel housing a two-by-three bank of square green lamps and one red lamp.
deleted.reason: Generic LED indicator panel that is visually indistinct and too minor for its own page.

deleted.name: e:kr-turnstile
deleted.depicts: A dark grey pedestal mounted with rotating silver barrier arms.
deleted.reason: Redundant synchronization prop whose concept is better covered by the core mutex.

deleted.depicts: Four grey vertical compartments beneath a copper header bar, three stacked with paired green or cyan fixed-width bars and one empty.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 2: glyph strip that reads as text

deleted.depicts: A small grey box on the left emitting a horizontal trail of red and grey rectangular dashes to the right.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 1: flat bar; reads as nothing

deleted.depicts: A heavy dark grey archway fitted with a lowered silver portcullis grate.
deleted.reason: Too similar in both visual form (portcullis archway) and concept to the Syscall Gatehouse in kernel-entry.

deleted.name: e:kr-runqueue
deleted.depicts: A horizontal two-tone grey track carrying cyan, yellow, green, and narrow red task blocks lined up in order.
deleted.reason: Redundant scheduler prop; the Round-Robin Wheel is a stronger visual for runnable task scheduling.

deleted.depicts: A square dark grey-framed screen showing four vertical bars, three cyan and one tall yellow column, above a silver baseline.
deleted.reason: Generic four-bar chart that is redundant with the Interrupt Bell for representing interrupts.

deleted.depicts: A grey-framed black panel holding a four-by-three grid of teal and navy cache slots with one bright white hit.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 1: panel of dots; abstract

deleted.depicts: A small grey-framed black panel displaying three horizontal progress bars, one green and two cyan, across dark blue tracks.
deleted.reason: Generic progress-bar panel that is redundant with the Round-Robin Wheel for scheduler accounting.

deleted.name: e:kr-ringbuf
deleted.depicts: An open circle of ten small square slots, seven dark grey and three sequentially lit bright cyan.
deleted.reason: Redundant with the Dmesg Marquee, which already represents the kernel ring buffer.

deleted.depicts: A grey-framed black console with a green indicator on the top left, a dark indicator on the top right, and a yellow-and-grey countdown bar below.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 1: UI panel with a bar

deleted.name: e:kr-vfs
deleted.depicts: A round silver junction hub with a red-and-charcoal core connected to four coloured conduits in green, cyan, magenta, and yellow.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 1: abstract gem/cross shape

deleted.name: e:kr-futex
deleted.depicts: A yellow-bordered black box enclosing two large square state cells, bright green on the left and coral red on the right.
deleted.reason: Visually plain two-cell box that is redundant with the Sleeping Padlock for mutex synchronization.

deleted.depicts: A cyan-framed black panel containing four vertical descriptor bars, three dark grey and one lit bright green.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 1: panel of bars

deleted.depicts: A grey-framed white enclosure subdivided into three nested coloured boxes: cyan-blue at top left, green at top right, and a wide red partition below.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 1: three coloured boxes

deleted.depicts: A dark grey horizontal rail carrying four alternating cyan and yellow square work items.
deleted.reason: Generic rail with alternating squares that overlaps with other scheduling and queue props.

deleted.name: e:kr-buddy
deleted.depicts: Three grey-bordered vertical strips showing power-of-two memory subdivision: a wide blue block, a half-width green block, and two stacked brown and red quarter-blocks.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 1: panel of coloured stripes
